summary: Bounce light: screen-space GI that lets sunlit walls, paving and roofs light what faces them in their colours.
stage: game capture at 1600x900, --offscreen --perf=0 --nohud: --host --team=0 --seed=3 --preset=high --mood=golden with FL_DEBUG_GI_CYCLE (frozen frame, each GI mode in turn) and FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES='street:town:32:-28:0.6;ruin:ruin:16:-58:0.4;alley:alley:16:-42:0'; pan clip: --fixed-fps 30 --set=ssgi:2,ssil:false --focus=8,-154 --zoom=30 --pitch=-35 --cam-yaw=1.57 --pan=0,20 --shots=60 --shot-every=0.0333 with FL_DEBUG_SSGI_VIEW=3, brightened
rationale: The change is a lighting difference on the same frame, so matched halves of one frozen frame with bounce light off and on show it best, in the three places it matters (street, a ruin's interior, between houses). Its stability while the camera pans is the motion question, answered by a short clip of the added light alone during a fast pan. Cost is measured in the pull request.
